_provenance: Population-training target-exclusion cohort. Two evidence tiers, both excluded IDENTICALLY: 'verified_usernames' (strong platform-level or first-party-style evidence, e.g. Lichess API verified=true, self-authored bio linking the player's own social media, or long-standing consistent public/journalistic identification) and 'conservative_candidate_usernames' (plausible but circumstantial -- kept and excluded anyway, since a missed target alias contaminates the corpus while an over-cautious exclusion only removes a negligible number of unrelated games). 'canonical_name' is a real-world provenance label only and is NEVER matched directly. Full evidence/source notes for each entry are recorded in project session history, not duplicated here. Compiled 2026-09-02 against Option D archives (2017-06, 2018-06, 2019-06, 2020-06, 2021-06); usernames with zero appearances there may still matter for other corpora and are kept for that reason.
